methodology: Eight authored source controls reviewed for requirement-conflict meaning separately from fixed reward-behavior labels before live predictions. References are model-reviewed development judgments, not human labels or a held-out accuracy benchmark. Full production extraction and every generated conflict question run without references. All outcomes, including extraction rejection, unavailable results, mismatches, failures and budget-limited runs, remain in the report. The ambiguous helper case accepts either no candidate or unavailable and is excluded from definite-only agreement. Dispatch does not establish an observed effect.
